ov: Fifteen species of large ground squirrels, the heaviest members of the squirrel family, from Asia, Europe and North America. They live in groups in summer and whistle loudly when alarmed, then spend the winter hibernating in burrows.
wt: About 2 kg in spring to 8 kg in autumn, sometimes over 11 kg
rg: Mountains such as the Alps, Carpathians and Sierra Nevada, and rough grassland across North America and the Eurasian steppe.
df: Greens and grasses, plus berries, lichens, mosses, roots and flowers.
fx: Alpine marmots can spend up to nine months a year hibernating.
Swiss Alpine peasants once ate marmots.
